summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage across unit, script, workflow, and integration layers. Unit tests (LabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, AssignLabels.Script.Tests.ps1) thoroughly exercise core logic: glob matching (7 tests), rule loading (6 tests), per-file label resolution (5 tests), multi-file aggregation (4 tests), and CLI behavior (5 tests). Good edge case coverage: case-insensitivity, priority conflicts, grouped rules, empty inputs, malformed JSON. However, integration tests (Invoke-ActTests.ps1) reference fixture files (fixtures/case1-docs.json through case4-no-match.json) that are not provided in the test code—these must exist for the act harness to function, and without seeing their contents, fixture-to-expectation correctness cannot be verified. Workflow structure tests validate YAML shape and actionlint, though workflow itself isn't shown. Minor gaps: no testing for glob patterns with special characters (?, brackets), paths with spaces, symlinks, or dot files; regex output parsing in act harness is somewhat fragile. Assumes properly-constructed fixture files exist.
